title: A. W. C. van Reede (Berlin) to the Secret Committee of the States General, 24 March 1793, in a marked three-digit code (DECODE R1893)

steps.what: Used the existing private DECODE cookie to download the record metadata, transcription (D3608) and manuscript images of R1893.
Separated R1893 as a different system because its three-digit groups carry systematic per-digit marks absent from the earlier dispatches.
Downloaded and inspected DECODE R2846 and the interlinearly decrypted control R2243 for related numerical systems.
Keys of the 1793 Fagel key bundle on DECODE examined: R2846, R2848, R2850 and R2851 (scripts fetch_key_thumbnails.py, index_key_digits*.py, extract_r2851_cells.py), with R2243; none reads R1893.
Assessed R1893 (696 marked three-digit tokens, 513 distinct) for ciphertext-only attack; code too large for the text, no key or crib found.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from vanreede1787, which had joined R1026/R1027 (William V's 1782 Grand Chiffre, R1024) with R1893 (1793, a different marked three-digit code). This profile keeps R1893 only.

WAINUT (PR #66): 44 of Van Reede's 1792-93 secret despatches in NA 1.01.02 inv. 6695 filed with their registered clear copies; number groups and copies transcribed with Gemini, 116 runs (10,250 groups, 8,286 words) aligned on uncoded clear words; hard-EM segmentation of each copy span gives 2,385 marked group forms (1,416 seen twice or more), wainut/code_marks.json.

WAINUT (PR #66): leave one letter out over the 44 training letters: coverage 0.897, 0.599 of groups exactly right, character similarity 0.701; shuffled code 0.003/0.203, rotated code 0.013/0.210; all 44 letters beat both controls.

WAINUT (PR #66): code applied to R1893: 601 of 696 groups in the code (459 supported, 142 tentative, 95 unknown); a character 5-gram model from the clear copies scores the true order above 200 permutations (z 10.0) but only z 2.7 against shuffled codes. Crib: groups 356-359 = 'Maarschalk Potocki' as in the PS of 16 June 1792. Hedged gist: Polish affairs before the Grodno Diet; no continuous translation.

Review of PR #66 (Bourdeau with Claude Opus 5.5): recorded as a proposal, not a reading (0.599 exact on held-out letters is below what a reading needs); outcome kept 'not solved', status 'attempted, partial'; shelfmark (R1893 not in the online inv. 6695 scans) and Fagel bundle coverage (only R2846, R2848, R2850, R2851 examined) reconciled in NOTES.
Method checked after George Lasry (24 Oct 2026) separated key and text: stays not solved, because no key and no crib; a ciphertext-only attack on the code is not feasible.

Brice Dudout reports the letter is not in the public scans of NA 1.01.02 inv. 6695, and that the online Fagel key books 1.10.29 inv. 1261, 1263 and 1265 (same family, not Van Reede's) describe null groups and 'Begin/Einde des Briefs' markers that may explain unknown groups at the start and end. Not yet checked here.

outcome.method_basis: R1893 uses a marked three-digit code with 513 distinct forms in 696 tokens; no key among the DECODE records tried and no crib, and at this ratio of text to code size a ciphertext-only attack is not feasible.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No group of ciphertext_R1893.txt is claimed as read.
outcome.notes: Attempted, closed unread 21 Sept 2026; attempted, partial since 21 Oct 2026: WAINUT's code rebuilt from inv. 6695 (PR #66) decodes R1893 in part, recorded as a proposal (leave-one-out 0.599 exact), not counted in fraction_read. DECODE's language tag HU is wrong (Dutch). Split 14 Oct 2026 from vanreede1787.

gaps.detail: different three-digit overmarked code; keys R2846, R2848, R2850, R2851, R2243 tried; WAINUT's rebuilt code (PR #66) reads it only as a proposal (601/696 groups valued, 0.599 leave-one-out exact); a deciphered copy (Fagel archive NA 1.10.29) not searched

credits.note: PR #66: code rebuilt from 44 cipher/clear pairs in NA 1.01.02 inv. 6695 and applied to R1893; partial decode recorded as a proposal (leave-one-out 0.599 exact)
Fagel key books 1261/1263/1265: nulls and begin/end markers

prior.where: no key or reading of R1893 found on DECODE or in print; WAINUT found no decipherment in the digitised inv. 6695 (21 Oct 2026); the Fagel archive (NA 1.10.29) and Colenbrander's Gedenkstukken not searched
